purpose: Owner thesis, 2026-09-07: cut the speech by SPEAKER first, then understand per speaker. The sealed full-44 direct baseline transports each call as ceil(D/90) fixed 90-second windows, and the cross-carrier silence-tail preregistration measured what that costs: 1,043 of the 1,593 windows (65.5 %) end on an ACTIVE frame and 1,088 of the 1,549 interior ones (70.2 %) end within 20 ms of active speech, while only 645 (40.5 %) carry exactly one speaker. This cell replaces the transport unit -- and nothing else -- with the hash-pinned v2 speaker-turn unit plan, whose 5,122 units end mid-speech 11.0 % of the time and carry exactly one speaker 76.1 % of the time, with zero units left under the 1.0 s minimum (v1's own 5,288-unit plan carried 166). Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e21-obs-speaker-turn-units-v1-preregistration.md (see the dated 2026-09-08 v2 addendum).

pairing.unit: the CALL -- 44 clusters. The comparator's 1,593 windows and this cell's 5,122 units do not align one to one and no construction makes them, so the call's pooled metrics are the only level at which both arms produce a complete comparable quantity.
pairing.statistic: analysis.paired.resampled_statistic on the pooled ratio sum(numerator)/sum(denominator) over the resampled call ids
pairing.power_limitation: n = 44 clusters is BELOW the program's n >= 400 rule for a paired effectiveness claim. That rule was answered on Earnings by pairing at the window (owner ruling 2026-09-06), and a transport unit that does not align to the window breaks that answer. This cell therefore reports an interval and a direction and makes NO paper-facing effectiveness claim.
pairing.secondary_read: preregistered and labelled: charging BOTH arms' alignment operations to the sealed 90-second window grid by REFERENCE index (the reference is the same string in both arms; an insertion goes to the window its reference cursor stands in) is a genuine common refinement at n = 1,593. It buys a saves/harms/ties count and the per-window strata, NOT power, and the 44-cluster interval stays the honest one.

decision.delta_convention: comparator minus cell, in points; positive = the cell is better

rule.win: CI90 LB(delta PERSON entity WER) > 0 AND CI90 LB(delta corpus WER) > 0
rule.win_entity_only: CI90 LB(delta PERSON entity WER) > 0 AND corpus WER non-inferior, i.e. CI90 LB(delta corpus WER) > -0.30 points
rule.no_effect: neither, and CI90 on both deltas contains 0
rule.harm: CI90 UB(delta PERSON) < 0 or CI90 UB(delta corpus WER) < -0.30, with the failing half named and the gap decomposed per stratum and per call

decision.non_inferiority_margin_basis: -0.30 points is six times the 0.05-point build-and-audio-path noise the sealed verdict measured, so it cannot be tripped by the noise it absorbs; and it is one tenth of the owner's 3.0-point alignment band around the published 9.71, so a cell that passes it has spent at most a tenth of the alignment budget and the 2026-09-04 ALIGNED verdict survives it intact.
harm_guards_reported_beside: semantic-high-impact-error-rate-v1 against 0.0278 % under the same taxonomy id (a weak guard by its own note's admission -- 100 HIGH reference words on all 44 -- and reported as a direction only)
the remaining seven ConEC classes and the non-entity rate
decision.falsifier_before_any_score: concatenating a call's unit slices with the 2.0-second tails removed must reproduce that call's sealed concatenated audio_sha256 from saea-diarization-v1, which holds if and only if the units tile and the cut is byte-exact against the sealed slices. A disagreement stops the cell before it is scored.
decision.equal_contact_question: A contact-matched control is IMPOSSIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION and is declared so before the flight: a call cut at its speaker turns yields 5,122 pieces (v2 plan), and there is no way to cut it into speaker-turn units and into 1,593 of them. The contrast therefore confounds boundary placement, speaker purity and contact count/length, both arms report contacts and delivered audio seconds in the verdict's first table, and the verdict states the confound in the same paragraph as the headline number. The control that WOULD separate contact count -- a fixed-window arm at obs_buffer_seconds 27.60, 5,122 windows, call it OBS-E1b -- is named as the follow-up and is deliberately NOT registered: two experiments in flight is forbidden.
decision.claim_surface: Discovery data. No superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim, and no paper-facing effectiveness claim at all (see pairing.power_limitation). No knob tuned on the evaluation ten: the plan's five rules were fixed model-free before any score existed. No Earnings-22 contact, no fstalign install, no diarizer re-run, no speaker naming.

execution_plan_basis.recomputed_for_v2: 2026-09-08. These three figures are recomputed for the v2 plan (5,122 units, not v1's 5,288); the formula is unchanged from v1's own -- only the unit count and delivered-audio input move. The registered ceilings (6,000 calls / 170,000 speech seconds / 4.0 GPU-h) are UNCHANGED: v2 needs strictly less of every one of the three than v1 did, so v1's ceilings already bound it with more margin than they bounded v1.
execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: the v2 unit count plus 10 % retry headroom: ceil(5,122 x 1.10) = 5,635 (513 calls of headroom for obs_slice_retry_max=1 retries); the registered exposure ceiling stays 6,000.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 151,589.853 s delivered (141,345.853 cut plus 5,122 x 2.0 s of tail) x 1.10 retry headroom = 166,748.838, rounded up to 167,000; the registered exposure ceiling stays 170,000.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: BRACKETED, not guessed, by the SAME formula v1 used, scaled by v2's own delivered audio and contact count against the comparator's realized 0.9734 GPU-h for 1,593 contacts over 141,345.85 s (0.973 GPU-h, 3,504.4 GPU-seconds) at this exact geometry, 40.3x realtime. Audio-proportional gives 0.9734 x 151,589.853 / 141,345.853 = 1.044 GPU-h (the floor, if cost tracks encoded seconds); contact-proportional gives 0.9734 x 5,122 / 1,593 = 3.130 GPU-h (the ceiling, if cost tracks requests) -- both strictly below v1's own 1.05 / 3.23 brackets, since v2 has fewer units and less delivered audio than v1 on the same 44 calls. 3.4 planned (the same 1.083x margin v1 applied to its own contact-proportional ceiling of 3.23 to reach 3.5) against the unchanged 4.0 ceiling covers the pessimistic bracket with more room than v1 had; the projection is re-measured on the smoke and the flight STOPS and reports if the measured rate projects past 4.0.
execution_plan_basis.budget_is_run_cumulative: core/model/adapter.py enforces planned_model_calls and planned_speech_audio_seconds across ALL attempts of a run id, so a partially spent attempt cannot be re-run under this id and the one permitted recovery would take a fresh run id and a fresh exposure row.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values.
